messages:
maria_sales: Hey team — NorthPeak Health asked for our SOC 2 report + some evidence for a POC. They want access this week if possible. Can we do a short-form NDA + presigned access to a scoped extract? :urgent:
ian_infosec: Who's the NorthPeak contact and what evidence exactly do they need? full report or scoped extracts (control walkthroughs, config screenshots, audit traces)?
rachel_legal: Prefer signed NDA before handing any extracts. We can offer an interim bridge letter / limited ack for POC data if sales needs faster turnaround. Need to confirm what data class the extracts include.
sam_se: For POC we usually provide a sanitized bundle: architecture diagrams, control descriptions, redacted config snippets, and some runbook steps. We can also spin up an ephemeral tenant (read-only) for a live demo to avoid sharing raw logs.
maria_sales: Contact is laura@northpeak.health. They specifically asked for "SOC 2 report + evidence of change control and access logging for the last 6 months." They said security team will sign a short NDA today if we can share presigned links.
ian_infosec: If it's only control docs + high-level logs we can do redacted extracts. No raw customer PII. Options: presigned S3 links with 48h expiry + IP allowlist, or a timeboxed guest tenant. Watermark PDFs and strip usernames.
rachel_legal: I'll prepare a two-paragraph bridge letter (acknowledgement of temporary access + non-disclosure terms) that can be countersigned quickly. But if they insist on full SOC 2 report PDF we need a signed NDA first. For the bridge we need: recipient name, email, and intended use statement.
storage-bot: Note: presigned links auto-expire; policy must be set to block downloads if encryption keys require customer-managed KMS.
maria_sales: OK — laura contact info provided above. Laura said "we can sign a short NDA or the bridge". Any estimate on turnaround if legal drafts bridge now? :pray:
rachel_legal: I can draft the bridge letter in ~4 business hours and send to sales. If they sign, InfoSec to prepare redacted extract within 24 hours after receipt of signed bridge. If they want full SOC 2 PDF, that'll require NDA + 48 hours for redaction review.
ian_infosec: I'll start preparing the extract checklist now: control descriptions, evidence filenames, redaction notes. For presigned link option — example AWS CLI presign we can use for an object:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-soc2-extracts/northpeak/controls-2025-03.zip --expires-in 172800
```
We'll set bucket policy to allow only laura@northpeak.health IP if provided.
sam_se: If helpful I can put together the sanitized bundle and a short demo tenant today. Needs an OK on bridge vs NDA from legal.
maria_sales: Laura replied — they prefer bridge letter to move faster. She can provide IP range. Please escalate, we have an internal QBR next week and need this closed. :thumbsup:
rachel_legal: Acknowledged. I'll DM the draft to you and laura for signature. Once signed, @ian_infosec proceed with the redacted extract flow.
ian_infosec: Will do. I'll also log the evidence release in our audit log and include a checksum file in the bundle.
maria_sales: Thanks all — please ping here when presign link ready so I can pass to NorthPeak.
ian_infosec: Update: presigned link prepared, expiry 48h, IP allowlist set to the range they provided. Sent the link to maria via DM.
rachel_legal: Bridge signed by NorthPeak at 2025-03-05T15:22Z. Legal retains copy.
maria_sales: Received link and sent to laura. She confirmed download started. I'll update thread after POC. :rocket:
